ayahOccurrences.text: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ

ayahOccurrences.text: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular imperfect verb, jussive mood
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَطْمِثْهُنَّ is in the derivative form: يَطْمِث
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ط/م/ث   ṭ–m–th to place a halter on a horse or camel for the first time, to graze a piece of land for the first time; to deflower; to menstruate. Of this root, only 1 form, يَطْمِث yaṭmith, occurs 2 times in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَطْمِث yaṭmith [imperf. v., trans.] to deflower

(55:56)‏فِيهِنَّ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنْسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلاَ جَانٌّ in them [the Gardens] there will be maidens with modest gaze, whom none before them, neither man nor jinn, has touched.
